question: 今年缴款金额排名前十的缴款人有哪些？
sql: SELECT paybook_full_high.fchgagenname AS fchgagenname, sum(paybook_full_high.famt) AS "非税缴款金额" FROM yunnan0508.fne_paybook_full_high AS paybook_full_high WHERE toDate(paybook_full_high.ffilldate) >= CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND toDate(paybook_full_high.ffilldate) < CAST('2027-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY paybook_full_high.fchgagenname ORDER BY "非税缴款金额" DESC LIMIT 10 SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1
